data.description: Experience the Best of Dubai Living at Binghatti Hillviews
data.display_address: Binghatti Hillviews, Dubai Science Park, Dubai
data.long_description:
Binghatti Hillviews is a stunning 44-storey residential tower in Dubai Science Park, crafted by Binghatti to offer contemporary elegance and comfort. With a selection of studios and 1-2 bedroom apartments, each residence is designed with meticulous detail, blending luxury with modern charm.

Hillviews creates an energizing atmosphere with amenities that extend beyond the residences. Residents can unwind in the adult pool, lounge on the poolside sundeck, exercise in the outdoor fitness area, or enjoy the basketball court. Families can make memories in the children’s pool, playground, and lush yoga area, offering spaces to recharge and relax.

Perfectly situated, Binghatti Hillviews is just three minutes from Dubai Hills Mall and a short drive to Mall of the Emirates, connecting residents effortlessly to Dubai's lively destinations while providing a serene retreat at home.
